# Phase 4 handoff — halo143 deploy window

> **Handoff note from 2026-07-20, ~04:30 UTC.** Pick up Phase 4 on **halo143**.
> halo150 is a separate session; this note covers only 143.

## Box state

```
host:      halo143 (10.0.1.143)
CT ID:     143 on pve (10.0.1.110)
substrate: Ubuntu 26.04, podman 5.7.0, py3.14, UNPRIVILEGED LXC
hal0:      0.9.8, installed from main (e3163605), serving at http://10.0.1.143:8080
data:      PRESERVED — 11 slots, 21 registered models, 1303 model-layout symlinks
render:    gid 991 (fixed 2026-07-20 — was 993 mapping to 'clock' not 'render')
```

## What's done

- CT reboot + GPU gid repaired (dev0/dev3 remapped to gid 991)
- hal0 0.9.8 installed from origin/main
- Model-layout migration applied (`hal0 migrate model-layout --apply`, 1303 symlinks)
- `/api/health` returns `{"status":"ok","version":"0.9.8"}`
- All doctor checks pass (12/12)

## What to do next (Phase 4 deploy window)

Per `docs/rework/handoff-r5-phase4.md`:

1. **Run migration windows:**
   - FLAGS-own migrator: `hal0 slot migrate-flags --apply` (from `config/migrations/slot_flags_fold.py`)
   - Honcho → Hindsight memory migration: `hal0 memory migrate --from honcho --to hindsight`
   - P2-updater-b verify (pipeline exists, verify + trim only)
   - P3-runtime-db: `state.json` → SQLite

2. **Deploy rehearsal:**
   - SLOT-B live flip: `hal0-slot@<name>` → `@<id>` (atomic, `migrate_id_keying.py`)
   - Golden-paths deploy runbook: `docs/rework/golden-paths-halo143-runbook.md`

3. **Live-validate:**
   - hal0.target reboot-autostart
   - Model-store PermRow perms
   - Hermes HP-executor first contact
   - Both-boxes record

## Access

```bash
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@10.0.1.143
# or via pve: ssh root@10.0.1.110 'pct exec 143 -- bash'
```
